senses.gloss: m. (גפן, v. H. Dict. s. v.) curve, trnsf. character of letters.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 9a:1">Meg. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>בג׳ שלנו</he> in our (Hebrew) characters, <he>בג׳ שלהן</he> in their (foreign) characters. [Ar. reads <cite ref="C00794"><he>גיפן</he></cite>.]—Y. ib. II, beg. 73ᵃ <he>שהיתה כתובה גיגנטון</he>, read: <he>שתהיה כתובה בגוֹפְנָן</he> it must be written in our characters (though in a foreign language).
